name: 20712 · Mount Rainier, MD
findings: ZIP 20712 (Mount Rainier) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20712 (Mount Rainier) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20712 (Mount Rainier) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
